descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S21 axe on the badge control, the Note Format picker and both add forms

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2; TFA-92584 AC 3)
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane fixture, both contexts

When Run axe on hospital-chart-preround, hospital-chart-encounter, hospital-add, nh-chart-preround, nh-chart-encounter and /snf/add

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations on the listed screens, including named form controls (the status select, the add-form toggle and Note Format)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core violations = 0 (visual-checks.ts) on the listed screens. From code reading on e02167f, not checked by this scenario: the status select is named 'Admission status' and the badge picture is aria-hidden (PatientCard.tsx AdmissionStatusControl); …

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
